title: Show the thinking pilot in the Pilots panel and on the sortie
goal: While a pilot thinks, the dashboard names it, its role, model, sortie and how long, and clears when the call ends
acceptance: Before the change read docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md (voice, tokens, type, spacing: var(--...) tokens only, no new literal colour; a new token or shared component updates the guide in the same change) and, if web/src is touched, docs/agents/angular.md; the dashboard files are web/public/dashboard/dashboard.js and live.js (renderMelons, renderSorties); the Angular migration (F-130-T10) keeps this requirement

The Pilots panel (Marduk Institute, melons) marks the thinking pilot's card with a live state naming pilot, role, model and sortie ID (e.g. Maya, Consultant, gemma4:26b, S-19EE) and the time it has been thinking; the sortie shows the same state in the same wording as its line (Maya S-19EE · Consultant (gemma4:26b)); a pilot not in the roster still shows, as Generic pilot, so no thinking is hidden

The elapsed time is counted on the client from startedAt, with one timer that runs only while something thinks and stops when the list is empty (no request per tick); a call that ends clears the mark on the next feed notification
EVA cages stay for EVA jobs only: the cage count and its subtitle do not change; a thinking pilot is never counted as an active EVA

Both voices are written (NERV theme and plain), the plain one without codenames; no backlog IDs (F-, B-, T-) in user-facing text; the state is readable without colour alone and announced to screen readers politely (aria-live), checked on a narrow viewport

A test across the endpoint, the feed and the rendered panel (test/dashboard-live-views.test.mjs style): a begin shows the entry with the elapsed time, an end removes it, an empty state shows nothing extra, and the cage count is unchanged; failing first
privacy: Neutral invented pilots, sorties and models only; no owner data or tokens in Git, tests or logs.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one marker in two renderers, one client timer, both voices and the join test. Not a measurement.
